title: Claude Marketplace Adds 14 Partner Agents for Security and Work
dek: Anthropic's marketplace now lists 25+ tools teams can use alongside Claude.

facts.label: Partner offerings now on the marketplace
New security agents, the biggest group

caption:
Your Claude budget can now pay for Datadog, Runway and Asana too. 👀

Anthropic just added 14 partner agents and products to Claude Marketplace, bringing it to more than 25 offerings. Security leads the batch with Chainguard, Checkmarx, Cyera, Rubrik and Tanium, alongside Datadog and Netlify for developers, Runway, Webflow and AirOps for creative work, and Asana, Glean, monday and Zoom for productivity.

The real hook: eligible enterprise customers can apply part of their committed Anthropic spend to these partner tools. One commitment covers Claude and the agents around it, which skips the slow budget approval step.

We're tracking how Anthropic is building an ecosystem around Claude here at AI Parabellum. Which of these would your team actually use?

post_caption:
Security is where enterprise AI demand is hottest right now, and Claude Marketplace proves it. Five of the 14 new partner listings focus on finding vulnerabilities and governing how Claude is used.

The rest span agent tracing, video generation, websites and workplace agents from names like Datadog, Runway, Webflow and Zoom. Eligible enterprises can put committed Anthropic spend toward all of them. 🔐
